limitations: One original complete everyday sock, counted as one family. No left/right, length, color or fabric variants. No parts extracted from boots, trousers or outfits.
Own approximate display scale: about 44 cm cuff-to-lowest surface. Single reference informs cuff, ankle, heel and rounded toe; exact measurements and unseen underside construction are generic.

Cuff is truly open. Foot and toe are closed. One continuous hollow mesh has authored approximately 1.8 mm radial wall thickness; this is a static visualization, not measured textile thickness. No hard sole.
Subtle cloth ripples and cuff rib relief are original approximate geometry, not a reproduction of a particular weave or sewing pattern.
No body, mannequin, rig, cloth simulation, wearable fit, operation, safety or Unity certification.
Private published BOSS stimulus has unverified original photographer/maker. No source image, logo, branding or photo textures included.
UVs use valid overlapping per-face planar projections, not a unique packed bake atlas. Plain materials require no external textures.
Actual unlabeled full and 128px renders reviewed as a recognizable sock; assistant visual judgment, not a player audience test.
metadata_note: Public copies remove workstation path metadata only. Geometry, UVs, materials and animation are retained; source photographs are excluded.
